_source.name: U.S. Senate — senators by class (Class II terms expire January 3, 2027; appointed Class III seats face a special election at the November 2026 general election)
_source.scope: Only the senators of the four covered states (CA, FL, NY, TX) are listed; House seats are all on the November 3, 2026 ballot by definition and are not listed here.
_source.method: Class II page lists Cornyn (R-TX); Class III page lists Moody (R-FL), who took the seat by appointment in 2025 and therefore faces a special election in November 2026. Schumer (NY, III), Padilla (CA, III), Gillibrand (NY, I), Scott (FL, I), Schiff (CA, I), Cruz (TX, I) are not up in 2026.
